text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after running a laid-back race
with Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —*Snoozing peacefully*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I'd like to start making moves
toward the next race soon,
Seiun Sky is as carefree as ever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: O-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky-san, I've been looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hello~... Wait,
Sei-chan, are you sleeping!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's fine.
She's just faking sleep anyway. Right, Sky-san?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Sky?
Wait, are you seriously asleep?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Zzz... snort.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky-san!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Geez... King, keep your voice down.
You'll wake the kids if you're not quiet.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorr—wait,
I don't have any kids!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, jokes aside.
Did you need something from me~?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There's only one reason I'd be here!
—This is a declaration of war!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: A declaration of war?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The royal road of racing—
the battle for the Classic Triple Crown—is finally about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Oho?
Please, do go on."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san, Special Week-san,
and myself! The first-class King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You know that they refer to us
as the 'Big Three', right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Since Grass Wonder-san is on break,
she won't be able to run in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And then there's El Condor Pasa.
She's declared she won't be running the classic route.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Meaning this year's Classic races are—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "It means we're gonna be the center of attention! Isn't that exciting, Sei-chan?!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Special Week-san!
That's not what we discussed!
You need to fire up Sky-san's fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry!
I just got carried away...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*. Regardless!
The one claiming this year's Triple Crown is King!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-NOOO!
This Special is the Triple Crown winner, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: O-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...2 out of 10. There wasn't even a punchline,
and above all, did you even rehearse?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This isn't a comedy skit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After King Halo and Special Week left...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I don't really get that comedy routine, but... Well, my general view pretty much aligns with King's.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess it's about time I got off my heavy butt and got moving.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So, we're aiming for the Classic Triple Crown. First up is the Satsuki Sho, so let's do this~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...A monumental goal was decided with such a casual tone!
However, the Classic Triple Crown is an Umamusume's greatest honor.
There's no reason not to take on the challenge."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...You sure are working hard, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess they won't bite unless I get serious~.
Maybe I'll try putting in some effort...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For an instant, Seiun Sky's eyes sparkled.
However, in the very next moment—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. Sei-chan is just gonna chill
and wait for a bite here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Seiun Sky was finally ready to make her full-fledged debut on the Classic stage!
